summary: Browserside media plumbing got a round of robustness and telemetry work: Firefox now records adoption and focus metrics for the Audio Session API (via Glean) so engineers can understand how sites use audio sessions, and various video-path checks were tightened to validate frame dimensions and constrain picture rectangles during conversion and encoding. These changes reduce crashes and visual corruption by preventing out-of-bounds image reads and by resetting picture regions when streams change. _No visible UI changes for most users, but playback is more stable._
